In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], an individual served as an [[Bomb disposal expert|'''explosives disposal officer''']] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. He was present at the [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege]]. They disabled the bombs that had been used to hold several hostages after the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] were neutralized by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]]
